description_en: Creates access credentials for a specified application group. This operation supports a dry run to preview the results
description_zh: 按需创建指定应用组的访问凭据，支持dryRun模式预览操作
kebab_example: aliyun opensearch create-app-group-credentials --dry-run true --type api-token --app-group-identity app_group_123 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateAppGroupCredentials

parameters.description_en: Specifies whether to perform a dry run. In a dry run, the system checks the request parameters but does not execute the operation.
parameters.description_zh: 指定此次操作是否为 dry run，即只检查参数，不实际执行操作。
parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to perform a dry run. In a dry run, the system checks the request parameters but does not execute the operation
parameters.help_zh: 指定此次操作是否为 dry run，即只检查参数，不实际执行操作
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.description_en: The credential type, such as \`api-key\`, \`account\`, \`invoke-key\`, or \`api-token\`. To create an API key, set this parameter to \`api-token\`.
parameters.description_zh: 凭据类型，如 api-key、account、invoke-key 或 api-token。创建 api-key 时写为 api-token。
